items.source: Resolve the supplied request and request path to a Resource that exists under one of the given resource locations.
items.translation: 将提供的请求和请求路径解析为存在于给定资源位置之一的Resource。

items.source: requestPath - the portion of the request path to use
items.translation: requestPath - 要使用的请求路径部分

items.source: locations - the locations to search in when looking up resources
items.translation: locations - 查找资源时要在其中搜索的位置

items.source: the resolved resource; or an empty Mono if unresolved
items.translation: 已解析的资源；或未解析时为空的Mono。

items.source: the resolved public URL path; or an empty Mono if unresolved
items.translation: 解析后的公开 URL 路径；或者如果未解析，则为空的 `Mono`。

items.source: This is useful when rendering URL links to clients.
items.translation: 这在向客户端渲染 URL 链接时非常有用。

items.source: A contract for invoking a chain of ResourceResolvers where each resolver is given a reference to the chain allowing it to delegate when necessary.
items.translation: 用于调用 ResourceResolvers 链的合约，其中每个解析器都会获得对该链的引用，以便在必要时进行委派。

items.source: Resolve the externally facing public URL path for clients to use to access the resource that is located at the given internal resource path.
items.translation: 解析客户端用于访问位于给定内部资源路径的资源的面向外部公共URL 路径。
